items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Sam Stiefel had the Pearl Theater over on the other side of Philadelphia that booked a lot of colored acts, too.

ctx.x: He must have been seeing a lot of pretty good acts --

Oh, yeah, yeah, uh-huh. We had quite a lot of comedians, like Sandy Burns, Sam Russell, George Wilkshire, God rest their souls. He had plenty of entertainment coming in that theater. Then he had opposition -- Sam Stiefel had the Pearl Theater over on the other side of Philadelphia that booked a lot of colored acts, too.
What kind of comedy were they doing in these acts?
